scenes.title: target spins to autoimmune
scenes.note: a CANCER target springs in from depth on 'target'; on 'isn't' it spins round to AUTOIMMUNE; on 'autoimmune' a dart flies in through depth and hits the bull (camera cranes with it); a small CANCER CAR-T disc drops below on 'market'; on 'larger' the target swells as the camera pulls back

scenes.title: clinic door shuts, IND waits at the slot
scenes.note: the three vials return on their tray seats on 'Three programs'; a clinic door lands above them on 'programs'; on 'none' its two leaves swing shut with one bounce; on 'next' an IND FILING envelope flies up through depth to the door's slot and stops there, not inside (camera pushes in with it)

scenes.title: $330M buys an option, not a product
scenes.note: the hook's brick steps back into its seat from the front on '$330 million' (reverses S1); on 'platform option' an OPTION ticket prints up out of its top (camera cranes); on 'not' a PRODUCT carton drops below; on 'product' it tips over backwards and falls out of the frame
